lines.text: Bet you can't watch this entire video without yawning once!
Your mouth opens super wide and you take in a giant gulp of air!
Are you just bored? No way! Your brain is an active supercomputer!
When your brain works hard thinking and playing, it heats up like a phone!
A big yawn acts like a cooling fan, pumping fresh cool air inside!
It cools your blood vessels and resets your energy levels instantly!
And when friends yawn together, your mirror neurons show you share feelings!
Your body has superpowers you use every single day without knowing!
Feed your curious brain and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
